digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: macOS test execution time increased from 15-20 minutes baseline to 30-40 minutes, driven by 870+ additional seconds in pytest execution and ~4.1k new default tests rather than mutation testing
mutation testing added at e0b3fdfc8e was not the direct cause of regression: 57 of 62 post-mutation runs skipped mutation entirely, and active mutation never extended the critical path

five specific unit tests execute expensive deterministic mechanics (120s jira timeout, five 5s sleeps, 25s retry backoff, 15-32s real socket/process windows) that together account for material shared latency
wiki corpus test cache fills per-xdist-worker instead of per-session due to process-local lru_cache, causing 174+ aggregate seconds of repeated corpus rendering work
org-level github free tier limits (20 total jobs/5 macos) amplify macos/process contention, causing nonlinear subprocess/apfs workload degradation under load
seven targeted coverage-neutral remediations identified in linked tickets that collectively recover 14+ minutes wall-clock without increasing runner parallelism or aggregate consumption
